The Sports Women

More room for women in sport.

Made withCapri
Our partContent strategy · Production · Editorial

Here’s the idea.

An ongoing editorial platform spotlighting women athletes and sporting moments across India.

For Capri, we run The Sports Women across Instagram and YouTube. The coverage spans Olympic journeys, women’s cricket, and major tournaments.

Fast edits, opinion documentaries, vox pops, and social-first stories make space for both the headline and the person behind it. The work is built around a consistent, accessible place for women’s sport.

Sport deserves a story between the highlights, too.
